verses.he: לְדָוִ֨ד ׀ שָׁפְטֵ֤נִי יְהוָ֗ה כִּֽי־אֲ֭נִי בְּתֻמִּ֣י הָלַ֑כְתִּי וּבַיהוָ֥ה בָּ֝טַ֗חְתִּי לֹ֣א אֶמְעָֽד׃
verses.ar: لِدَاوُدَ اِقْضِ لِي يَارَبُّ لِأَنِّي بِكَمَالِي سَلَكْتُ، وَعَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ تَوَكَّلْتُ بِلَا تَقَلْقُلٍ.
verses.en: A Psalm of David. Judge me, O LORD, for I have walked in mine integrity, and I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
verses.kjv: [A Psalm] of David. Judge me, O LORD; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the LORD; [therefore] I shall not slide.
verses.web: By David. Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.

verses.ar: جَرِّبْنِي يَارَبُّ وَٱمْتَحِنِّي. صَفِّ كُلْيَتَيَّ وَقَلْبِي.
verses.en: Examine me, O LORD, and try me; test my reins and my heart.
verses.kjv: Examine me, O LORD, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.
verses.web: Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ رَحْمَتَكَ أَمَامَ عَيْنِي. وَقَدْ سَلَكْتُ بِحَقِّكَ.
verses.en: For Thy mercy is before mine eyes; and I have walked in Thy truth.
verses.kjv: For thy lovingkindness [is] before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.
verses.web: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

verses.he: לֹא־יָ֭שַׁבְתִּי עִם־מְתֵי־שָׁ֑וְא וְעִ֥ם נַ֝עֲלָמִ֗ים לֹ֣א אָבֹֽוא׃
verses.ar: لَمْ أَجْلِسْ مَعَ أُنَاسِ ٱلسُّوءِ، وَمَعَ ٱلْمَاكِرِينَ لَا أَدْخُلُ.
verses.en: I have not sat with men of falsehood; neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.kjv: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.
verses.web: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

verses.he: שָׂ֭נֵאתִי קְהַ֣ל מְרֵעִ֑ים וְעִם־רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים לֹ֣א אֵשֵֽׁב׃
verses.ar: أَبْغَضْتُ جَمَاعَةَ ٱلْأَثَمَةِ، وَمَعَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ لَا أَجْلِسُ.
verses.en: I hate the gathering of evil doers, and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.kjv: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.
verses.web: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

verses.he: אֶרְחַ֣ץ בְּנִקָּיֹ֣ון כַּפָּ֑י וַאֲסֹבְבָ֖ה אֶת־מִזְבַּחֲךָ֣ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: أَغْسِلُ يَدَيَّ فِي ٱلنَّقَاوَةِ، فَأَطُوفُ بِمَذْبَحِكَ يَارَبُّ،
verses.en: I will wash my hands in innocency; so will I compass Thine altar, O LORD,
verses.kjv: I will wash mine hands in innocency: so will I compass thine altar, O LORD:
verses.web: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh,

verses.ar: لِأُسَمِّعَ بِصَوْتِ ٱلْحَمْدِ، وَأُحَدِّثَ بِجَمِيعِ عَجَائِبِكَ.
verses.en: That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and tell of all Thy wondrous works.
verses.kjv: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.
verses.web: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

verses.he: יְֽהוָ֗ה אָ֭הַבְתִּי מְעֹ֣ון בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מְקֹ֗ום מִשְׁכַּ֥ן כְּבֹודֶֽךָ׃
verses.ar: يَارَبُّ، أَحْبَبْتُ مَحَلَّ بَيْتِكَ وَمَوْضِعَ مَسْكَنِ مَجْدِكَ.
verses.en: LORD, I love the habitation of Thy house, and the place where Thy glory dwelleth.
verses.kjv: LORD, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.
verses.web: Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

verses.he: אַל־תֶּאֱסֹ֣ף עִם־חַטָּאִ֣ים נַפְשִׁ֑י וְעִם־אַנְשֵׁ֖י דָמִ֣ים חַיָּֽי׃
verses.ar: لَا تَجْمَعْ مَعَ ٱلْخُطَاةِ نَفْسِي، وَلَا مَعَ رِجَالِ ٱلدِّمَاءِ حَيَاتِي.
verses.en: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with men of blood;
verses.kjv: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:
verses.web: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ رَذِيلَةٌ، وَيَمِينُهُمْ مَلآنَةٌ رِشْوَةً.
verses.en: In whose hands is craftiness, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.kjv: In whose hands [is] mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.
verses.web: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

verses.ar: أَمَّا أَنَا فَبِكَمَالِي أَسْلُكُ. ٱفْدِنِي وَٱرْحَمْنِي.
verses.en: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity; redeem me, and be gracious unto me.
verses.kjv: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.
verses.web: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

verses.he: רַ֭גְלִי עָֽמְדָ֣ה בְמִישֹׁ֑ור בְּ֝מַקְהֵלִ֗ים אֲבָרֵ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: رِجْلِي وَاقِفَةٌ عَلَى سَهْلٍ. فِي ٱلْجَمَاعَاتِ أُبَارِكُ ٱلرَّبَّ.
verses.en: My foot standeth in an even place; in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
verses.kjv: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the LORD.
verses.web: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.
